scenario.description: Selects the deterministic journey this claim follows, so the run is reproducible.

injuryTypeCode.description: The injury reported at notification, such as whiplash, soft tissue, fracture, head injury or psychological.

independentLivingFlag.description: Whether the claimant can still live independently without care support.

reserveGeneralDamages.description: The general damages reserve for pain and suffering set at registration.

litigationEventCode.description: Litigation trigger identifier when proceedings or a pre-action protocol step are live on the claim. Empty when no litigation trigger applies.

claimStatus.description: The handling track for this claim. Must be exactly one of: "Desktop", "Field", "Specialist", "CAT Surge". The case routes on this value, so it must never contain any other value.

agentRationale.description: The reasoning behind the handling track, kept separate from the decision itself. This is what a person reads.
